'''Mieq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She made her living as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] selling [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts in the [[Olaris Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mieq first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a starship upgrade vendor on Taris in the Olaris Spaceport.
